summary: Full-extraction pass over 16 stored UAE golden-visa documents (legislation, ICP/GDRFA/DLD/ADRO service pages, WAM and GDRFA news). Main find: the stored PDF of Cabinet Resolution 65/2022 contains the golden-residence annex that the first pass could not read, so the 2022 investor thresholds now rest on the legal text. Added 3 observations, 40 rules and 1 event; 14 documents complete, 2 partial (green, retiree and property-owner residence routes have no programme row).

observations.quote: can make a combined investment estimated at AED100 billion
observations.notes: Investments of the 6,800 people identified as eligible in the first year; Gulf News report of the GDRFA Dubai press conference of 25 Jun 2019, relayed by WAM. Same round figure as the launch announcement. Period 2019 as for the 6,800 row from this article (the first year of the initiative).

observations.quote: In January, the government also granted the first batch of long-term visas to 20 scientists
observations.notes: First batch of long-term visas, to winners and finalists of the Mohammad Bin Rashid Medal for Scientific Excellence; talent category, not investors. The article (3 Jun 2019) says "In January" without a year; January 2019 is the January before publication. Official news-agency statement, recorded as claim.

observations.quote: granted golden visas to 20 investors belonging to 12 nationalities
observations.notes: Grantees in one Dubai Land Department ceremony batch (five-year real-estate golden visas). Para 2 lists the 12 countries (Tunisia, USA, Dominica, India, Iraq, China, Libya, Jordan, Iran, Pakistan, Kazakhstan, Saint Kitts and Nevis) without counts per country; the Dominica and Saint Kitts and Nevis nationals are presumably CBI citizens (not stated).

events.title: First golden residence permit issued in Abu Dhabi
events.description: The Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship (ICA) issues the first golden residence permit in Abu Dhabi under Cabinet Resolution 56/2018, to a prominent investor, at a ceremony.
events.quote: The Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship, ICA, issued the first "Golden Residence Permit" in Abu Dhabi

gaps: No investor-only count of golden visas in any of these documents: all counts are all-category, mostly Dubai.
Cabinet Resolution 8/2021 (golden residence, 2021-2022) is still not stored, so the date the AED 2 million thresholds started is not established.

ledger.contains: Abu Dhabi Residents Office page (undated, viewed 2026-10-02) on the two investor golden visas (10 years): non-real-estate (deposit or company of at least AED 2 million, or AED 250,000 a year in taxes for 2 years; covers spouse, children, one advisor, one executive director) and real estate (AED 2 million outside a mortgage, mortgages via national banks, off-plan with AED 2 million paid); document requirements and how to apply. No statistics, no fees.

Cabinet Resolution 56/2018 (8 pages, Arabic): definitions; investor permits (AED 10 million fund deposit, company or mixed with 60% non-real-estate, 10 years; AED 5 million property, 5 years; 3-year holding, AED 10 million solvency, health insurance, up to 3 domestic-worker visas, 6-month entry permit, one senior employee); entrepreneurs (previous project of AED 500,000 or incubator approval, 5 years); talents and researchers (doctors, scientists, artists, inventors, executives with AED 30,000 salary, educators, athletes; 10 years); outstanding students (95% or GPA 3.75; 5 years); committees; in force 3 Feb 2019. Entrepreneur, talent and student criteria are out of scope (same choice as for the federal portal page, are-uae-portal-golden-visa). No statistics.

Legislation-platform page showing the 15 Apr 2020 amendment of Res. 56/2018: new wording of art. 1 (talent definition adds sports) and art. 8 (talent categories, adds athletes), with the previous texts. The numbers on the page (top 500 universities, 10 years of experience, AED 30,000 salary for executives, 6-month entry permit, one domestic worker) are talent criteria, out of scope and unchanged from the original. Investor terms not touched. Already recorded as an event.

Cabinet Resolution 65/2022, executive regulation of Decree-Law 29/2021 (39 pages, Arabic; consolidated text that also mentions a later "blue residence" annex, art. 77 bis, which is not included). Main text: visa and entry-permit types; residence permits (2 years standard; 5-year green residence for investors/partners, skilled workers with AED 15,000 salary, freelancers with AED 360,000 income; remote work USD 3,500 a month; retirees with AED 1 million property or deposit or AED 240,000 income, 5 years; property owners, AED 10,000 monthly income); family sponsorship (children to 25); 180-day absence rule with investors exempt; fines; repeal of Res. 8/2021; in force 3 Oct 2022. Annex on golden residence (pp. 29-39), which the earlier pass could not read and is in this stored copy: 10-year permits; investor thresholds (AED 2 million deposit, company, partnership, property, off-plan; AED 250,000 a year tax); family, entry visa; entrepreneurs (AED 1 million revenue, or a previous project sold for AED 7 million), talents, scientists, professionals (AED 30,000 salary), students, humanitarian pioneers (financial supporters AED 2 million), frontline workers. Investor terms, general golden-residence rules and the humanitarian AED 2 million threshold extracted; entrepreneur, talent, scientist, professional and student criteria out of scope.
ledger.to_do: Not extracted because the dataset has no programme row for them: 5-year green residence for investors or partners (art. 38(2), 41; thresholds left to a decision of the ICP chairman), retiree residence with property or deposit of at least AED 1,000,000 (art. 51-52, PDF p. 20), and non-golden residence for property owners (art. 53, AED 10,000 monthly income, no property minimum). Decide whether these belong in the dataset; if so, add a programme and the terms.

ledger.contains: Federal Decree-Law 29/2021 on entry and residence of foreigners (38 articles, Arabic): framework only; types, conditions and durations of visas and residence permits are left to the executive regulation (arts 7-8); deportation; general penalties (e.g. art. 26: breach of residence-permit conditions, up to 3 months and AED 10,000; art. 28: legal persons AED 50,000); in force 30 days after publication. Nothing specific to the golden visa or investors; dates already recorded as an event.

Dubai Land Department e-service page (viewed 2026-10-02) for the real-estate golden visa: AED 2 million property (mortgage allowed with AED 2 million paid), 10-year renewable permit, spouse, children and parents; itemised fees for the investor (total AED 9,884.75, components in the existing note), family and parent permits (AED 5,774.50 each), family file AED 318.75, AED 100 per sponsored person; service time 7-10 business days; documents, channels and accredited centres. No statistics.

GDRFA Dubai service page (viewed 2026-10-02) for golden residence for investors: requirements for company investor/partner, bank deposit, real estate and tax investor (AED 2 million; AED 250,000 tax a year); fees (AED 1,100 permit, AED 10 knowledge and innovation dirhams, AED 500 in-country, AED 20 delivery, AED 100 a year increase over two years); 10-year validity; deposit frozen at least 2 years (and not withdrawable for 10 years); expected completion 5 days; exemption from the 180-day absence rule; list of service centres. No statistics.

GDRFA Dubai news on its 2022 results: golden visas issued (all categories) 79,617 in 2022 and 47,150 in 2021 (already recorded); the rest is general transaction volume (62.2 million transactions, entry/exit, visa and residency transactions, passports, legal consultations), satisfaction indices and staff, out of scope.

GDRFA Dubai news (16 Nov 2022) from its 2022 inspection report: 151,666 golden visas issued 2019-2022 (already recorded; the headline "more than 152,000" rounds it); the rest is transactions of the residency sector (15.5 million), service and satisfaction indicators, out of scope.

WAM, 30 Jan 2021: amendments to the nationality executive regulation allowing investors, doctors, specialists, scientists, inventors, talents, intellectuals, artists and families to be nominated for citizenship while keeping their nationality; investors must own property in the UAE (no amount); other categories need 10 years of experience, patents or awards; oath of allegiance; citizenship revocable. Event already recorded; investor property condition added as a rule. No numbers of grants.

WAM, 11 Jul 2019: Dubai Land Department ceremony granting five-year golden visas to 20 real-estate investors of 12 nationalities (countries listed, no counts per country), property worth over AED 200 million, threshold over AED 5 million each; Cube Centre services. 20 investors and AED 200 million already recorded; nationalities count and the threshold added.

WAM, 18 Apr 2022: Cabinet approves the executive regulation of the entry and residence decree-law: 10-year golden residence for investors, entrepreneurs (AED 1 million revenue or a project sold for AED 7 million), talents, scientists, professionals (AED 30,000 salary), students, humanitarian pioneers, frontline heroes; family sponsorship regardless of age, no limit on time abroad; real-estate route AED 2 million incl. bank loans and off-plan; 5-year green residence for skilled employees (AED 15,000), freelancers (AED 360,000), investors/partners (replacing a 2-year permit); visit visas (5-year tourist visa, USD 4,000 balance, 90/180 days); grace periods up to 6 months; in force 90 days after publication. Investor golden terms and the event are recorded; entrepreneur, talent and other visa criteria are out of scope.

ledger.contains: WAM relaying Gulf News, 26 Jun 2019: GDRFA Dubai press conference: 400 golden visas issued UAE-wide so far, target 6,800 by end of 2019, from 70 countries, combined investment estimated at AED 100 billion; 10-year renewable visas; no minimum stay; capacity of 30-40 appointments a day (a statement of capacity, not a count, not recorded); executive directors with AED 30,000 salary eligible as talents (out of scope). 400 and 6,800 already recorded; AED 100 billion added.

WAM, 11 Jan 2023, relaying GDRFA Dubai: golden visas issued in all categories 79,617 in 2022 and 47,150 in 2021 (already recorded); the rest is general transaction volume (62.24 million transactions etc.) and satisfaction indices, out of scope.

WAM, 21 May 2019: launch of the Golden Card by Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid for investors, entrepreneurs, talents, researchers and students; first 6,800 qualifying residents from over 70 countries with current investments estimated at AED 100 billion; spouse and children included. All numbers and the launch event already recorded.

WAM, 3 Jun 2019: ICA issues the first golden residence permit in Abu Dhabi (event added); 6,800 eligible investors with AED 100 billion of investments (already recorded); summary of Res. 56/2018 investor terms (AED 5 million property for 5 years; AED 10 million deposit, company or partnership, or mixed with 60% non-real-estate, for 10 years; holding 3 years; partners AED 10 million each; one executive director and one advisor; 6-month multiple-entry visa) (main thresholds added as rules); first batch of long-term visas to 20 scientists in January (added).
